label: An efficient cause does not depend for its being on what it efficiently causes, from asymmetry
meaning: Derives the batch 1 bridge that an efficient cause does not depend for its being on its effect. An efficient cause c of x is distinct from x (the secunda via's no-self-causation, stated by the q.2 a.3 claim); x depends for its being on c (q.44 a.1 ad 2 read as dependence); distinct things do not depend on each other mutually (OPEN). Argument-level cycle: NO-SELF-EFFICIENT-CAUSATION-FROM-DEPENDENCE derives no-self-causation from this conclusion; here no-self-causation is used as the stated source premise.
